item.title: PASS: Perturbation augmented space group structure sampling for transferable Fe-O machine learning interatomic potential
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Zixiong Wei, Fei Shuang, Poulumi Dey
arXiv:2607.28000v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate atomistic modelling of iron (Fe) oxidation requires a reliable interatomic potential, which necessitates an extensive and representative first-principles dataset for training the interatomic potential. However, Fe-oxygen (O) system is known for its structural and magnetic complexity, rendering the generation of high-quality dataset challenging. In this work, we propose the Perturbation Augmented Space group structure Sampling (PASS) method to generate extensive and representative dataset consisting of small-cell structures with less than 10 atoms. We present a systematic approach to developing a first of its kind transferable machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) for Fe-O system based on the atomic cluster expansion (ACE) fr…

item.title: MSGNN：基于新型磁性符号拉普拉斯算子的谱图神经网络
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yixuan He, Michael Permultter, Gesine Reinert, Mihai Cucuringu
该文提出“磁性符号拉普拉斯”矩阵，作为符号图拉普拉斯与有向图磁性拉普拉斯的自然推广，用于同时编码边的符号信息和方向信息。基于该矩阵，作者构建了高效谱图神经网络 MSGNN，并在节点聚类和链路预测任务上进行系统测试。结果表明，该方法能有效融合符号与方向结构，在多类数据集上取得领先性能；文中还提出了符号有向随机块模型及若干基于金融时间序列领先—滞后关系的新数据集。

item.title: Long-Range Machine Learning of Electron Density for Twisted Bilayer Moiré Materials
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Zekun Lou, Alan M. Lewis, Mariana Rossi
arXiv:2602.09938v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Moiré superlattices in two-dimensional (2D) materials exhibit rich quantum phenomena, but ab initio modelling of these systems remains computationally prohibitive. Existing machine learning methods for accelerating density-functional theory (DFT) can target the prediction of different quantities and often rely on the locality assumption. Here we train a Gaussian process regression SALTED model exclusively on the electron densities of small displaced bilayer structures and then extrapolate electron density prediction to the large supercells required to describe small twist angles between these bilayers. We show the necessity of long-range descriptors to yield reliable band structures and electrostatic properties of large twisted bilayer s…

item.title: Graph Neural Network Force Fields for Spin Dynamics in Metallic Magnets
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Ali Rayat, Yunhao Fan, Gia-Wei Chern
arXiv:2607.28537v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Metallic magnets exhibit complex spin dynamics governed by electronically generated interactions. Predictive simulations of such dynamics typically require repeated solutions of an underlying electronic problem throughout the time evolution, creating a major computational bottleneck. Here we introduce a graph neural network (GNN) magnetic force-field framework that learns the effective magnetic energy functional governing itinerant spin dynamics directly from electronic calculations. Conceptually analogous to machine-learned interatomic potentials, the proposed framework enables efficient evaluation of spin torques while capturing the nonlinear and spatially extended interactions generated by itinerant electrons. We benchmark the method on r…

item.title: 结合拓扑数据分析与机器学习预测多孔介质渗透率
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Ebru Dagdelen, Catherin Neena Lalu, Aakash Karlekar, Manav Arora, Matthew Illingworth, Jonathan Jaquette, Linda Cummings, Lou Kondic
该研究讨论如何从合成多孔介质数据中提取几何结构、拓扑连通性和孔隙网络等特征，并将其作为机器学习输入以预测渗透率。作者以单独计算得到的精确渗透率作为基准，比较不同特征组合对预测性能的贡献，从而评估各类结构度量对渗流性质的表征能力。结果强调拓扑数据分析提供的连通性信息对从孔隙结构预测渗透率具有重要价值。

The funnel approach reduced computational…

item.title: Deep Learning for Accelerated Long-Horizon Forecasting of Multicomponent Multiphase Microstructure Evolution in High-Entropy Alloys
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Hamidreza Razavi, Nele Moelans
arXiv:2607.27820v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phase-field modeling provides a powerful approach for predicting microstructure evolution but becomes computationally prohibitive for multicomponent and multiphase systems over large spatial and temporal scales. A multi-head autoencoder compresses the four elemental concentration fields and phase-field order parameter into latent representations, which are formulated as graphs for learning their spatial and temporal evolution. The framework accurately forecasts microstructure evolution over horizons extending to 3,000,000 simulation ti…

item.title: 利用电导率信息相关函数预测碳纳米管-聚合物纳米复合材料多功能性能的数据驱动机器学习模型

Application of the method to single-cylinder, concentric multilayer cylindrical shells, three arbitrarily arranged cylinders, and composite irregular structures demonstrates that for the TM polarization, all relative L² errors mostly remain at particularly low…

item.title: 通过Ising求解器实现神经网络鲁棒性的精确与渐近完备验证
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Wenxin Li, Wenchao Liu, Weihao Li, Chuan Wang, Qi Gao, Yin Ma, Hai Wei, Kai Wen
该工作提出与Ising模型兼容的形式化框架，用于验证有界输入扰动下神经网络的鲁棒性。对于分段线性激活函数，精确对数PWL模型以信息论最小的对数编码给出精确、可靠且完备的表述，减少每个神经元所需二进制变量；对于一般有界逐元素激活函数，渐近阶梯包络模型用保守的分段常数上下包络近似，并证明当分段宽度趋零时全局优化输出界一致收敛到真实网络极值。作者还开发混合Benders求解器，并结合区间剪枝、剪枝网络证书转移和逐层经典-Ising划分以降低自旋资源需求。

item.title: 用于工艺参数驱动预测 TiO₂–PVP 静电纺纳米纤维直径的可解释集成机器学习
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Chetan More, Harshada Mhetre, Kedar Sahasrabudhe, Asmita Mali, Sameer Gajmal, Amol Bhopale 等7位作者
该工作面向 TiO₂–PVP 静电纺纳米纤维直径预测，构建基于工艺参数的可解释集成机器学习框架。研究动机在于纤维直径直接影响比表面积、孔隙率、力学性质和应用功能，而聚合物浓度、电压、流速、针尖—收集器距离等参数之间存在高度非线性耦合。相比传统实验设计优化，机器学习方法有望更高效地刻画高阶相互作用并辅助精确工艺控制。

arXiv:2607.27681v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transient-stability assessment determines whether a power system can recover after a disturbance and is therefore essential to preventing generator trips and cascading outages. A key metric is the critical clearing time (CCT), which specifies the maximum time available to clear a fault before synchronism is lost. Reliable CCT estimation is challenging because complicated fault-clearing dynamics require repeated simulations over many fault severities and clearing times. We propose an event-structured physics-informed neural network (ES-PINN) that aligns its representation with the pre-fault, fault-on, and post-clearing swing dynamics and enforces exact state chaining across event interfaces. A smooth trajectory-induced stability margin define…

item.title: Comparison of a Parametric Physics-Informed Neural Network and a Tensorial Reduced-Order Model for the Shallow-Water Dam-Break Problem
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Anton Myshak, Md Rezwan Bin Mizan, Ilya Timofeyev
arXiv:2607.27433v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop two parametric data-driven reduced models: a physics-informed neural network (PINN) and a non-intrusive tensorial reduced-order model (TROM), and apply both approaches to the parametrized one-dimensional shallow-water dam-break problem. Both reduced models do not require time integration and learn a direct solution map from space, time, and dam-break parameters to the physical state. We present a detailed comparison for out-of-sample and extrapolated parameter values. In addition, we demonstrate that it is essential to introduce shock-aware collocation to improve the robustness of the PINN model.

arXiv:2607.27693v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets combine collinear antiferromagnetic order with nonrelativistic spin splitting, enabling spintronic functionalities without relying on spin--orbit coupling. We show that structural relaxation consistently reconstructs the crystal-field landscape, activating a common dₓz/dyz orbital manifold that drives spontaneous staggered orbital ordering and robust d-wave nonrelativistic spin splitting across transition-metal compounds spanning electron fillings from d¹ to d⁷. item.title: Optimization of Epitaxial Mn4N Thin Films Grown by Sputtering for Spintronic Applications
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Teodor Apetrei, Emre Demiroglu, Caner Deger, Can Onur Avci, Silvia Damerio
arXiv:2607.27419v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferrimagnetic Mn4N has recently emerged as a promising rare-earth-free platform for spintronic devices due to its low magnetization, high domain wall mobility, and strong anomalous Hall response. However, the realization of thin films with robust perpendicular magnetic anisotropy (PMA) and spin-orbit torque (SOT) functionality through scalable deposition techniques remains a significant challenge. 👤 Di Zhu, Zhongbo Yan, Mohsen Yarmohammadi
arXiv:2607.27335v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Parity is a central characteristic of momentum-dependent spin splitting in antiferromagnets (AFMs). Yet, intrinsic crystal symmetries typically restrict the splitting to either even or odd parity, preventing flexible spin control. Using a coplanar AFM, we demonstrate that bichromatic (ømega--nømega) Floquet driving offers a natural way to bypass this constraint. This mechanism generates asymmetric spin textures unattainable in static AFMs or under monochromatic driving. item.title: Coupled Spin-Density-Wave and Bond-Order Driven Metal-Insulator Transition in Altermagnetic CsCr₂S₂O
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Chenchao Xu, Wansheng Bai, Guo-Xiang Zhi, Yi Liu, Xiaoqun Wang, Jianhui Dai, Chao Cao
arXiv:2607.28329v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A metal-insulator transition (MIT) driven by bond order (BO) coupled with a secondary spin-density wave (SDW) is identified in CsCr₂S₂O. Such coupling is enabled as a result of the broken time-reversal symmetry due to the pre-existing C-type antiferromagnetic (C-AFM) order. Thus the low-energy physics is governed by the Cr-dₓz and S-p_z orbitals. arXiv:2607.27884v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the chaotic dynamics driven in the nonlinear regime of ferromagnetic resonance of an out-of-plane magnetized nanodisk in detail. item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 B. J. Ramshaw
arXiv:2607.28365v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The confirmation of a bulk, topological superconductor is a central goal of modern quantum materials research. Despite decades of searching, no confirmed examples yet exist. A primary difficulty is that most experimental signatures of topological superconductivity are ambiguous and indirect. item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Zheng-Yang Zhuang, Zhongbo Yan
该研究提出由自旋反转镜面对称而非自旋反转旋转对称控制的条纹序交替磁性，因此超出通常基于旋转的 l 波交替磁分类。基于双轨道模型，作者显示条纹自旋序与轨道序耦合可产生具有镜面对称约束向列自旋劈裂的条纹交替磁，也可形成能带自旋简并的条纹反交替磁；后者在适当起伏结构中可能支持类似铁电的电控自旋劈裂。随机相近似计算表明，强跃迁各向异性和近半填充条件有利于条纹序交替磁性，并预言其具有纯横向 Drude 自旋流响应，可通过自旋分辨镜面和旋转探针与传统 l 波交替磁区分。
